translations.synopsis: Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter is a 2002 action video game for the PlayStation 2 and Xbox, developed and published by LucasArts. It is the sequel to Star Wars: Starfighter. Jedi Starfighter takes place just prior to the events of Attack of the Clones and during the Battle of Geonosis. On November 17, 2015, it was re-released for the PlayStation 4 in North America as part of the Star Wars Battlefront limited edition console bundle.
translations.title: Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter
